description: Plans fail-closed CI, release, and deploy impact from the source-owned component graph and runs only explicitly allowlisted compile-codegen checks.
checks: node --test --test-timeout=300000 tool/harness/lib/git_changes.test.mjs tool/harness/lib/flutter_document_selection.test.mjs tool/harness/lib/flutter_contract_outputs.test.mjs tool/lib/path_glob.test.mjs tool/harness/component_graph.test.mjs tool/harness/check_flutter_l10n_generated.test.mjs tool/harness/harness_cli.test.mjs tool/harness/workflow_wiring.test.mjs

rules.title: Use read-only impact planning for broad AI-assisted work
rules.instruction: For broad work, inspect the Git diff and use the read-only Catch planner to explain affected components and checks. Run the selected checks and preserve proof in Git and CI. Do not write registry receipts, readiness metrics, or regression ledgers.
